Hi all, and welcome to the new Shingeki no Kyojin Subverse! My name is Luxx, and I'm the first moderator here at SnK! Before we get started, I would like to take the time to give you some information about myself (an introduction before the introduction, if you will) so we can become better acquainted and hopefully more established as a result. I'm sure you would probably like to know more about the person moderating the sub, after all, and I feel it only makes sense that the community know as much as possible about the people who are/will be leading the sub in the future as to avoid any discrepancies.

A little about me: Ever since I was a little child, I loved all things gaming and anime related. If it could capture my imagination with beautiful imagery, sounds, and stories, then I was probably into it. Back in the day, I started my nerdy lifestyle by playing Super Mario Bros. on the original Nintendo Entertainment System and watching my sister play Pokemon on the Gameboy Color. Little did I know that my love for these things would eventually spark a yearning to see even more creative works that I could become fully immersed in; one of those things being Shingeki no Kyojin. Soon after, that same sister introduced me to anime on Toonami such as Bleach, Case Closed, Full Metal Alchemist, and more, which led to me seeking other anime and manga. For awhile, I was obsessed with Japanese pop culture, and to an extent, I still find myself enjoying it, but probably not as much as I did then. Nonetheless, one day, my friend told me about this gory anime that was unlike anything they had ever seen that involved giant humanoid creatures attacking humans and the humans attempting to fight off the giant humanoids with these awesome devices that allowed the humans to zip around. Despite my friend's goofy and slightly incohesive description, I found myself intriqued. I figured, well hey, I ought to give this unconventional sounding anime a shot. And now...

Here I am, having watched through the entirety of the first season and all caught up on the manga chapters. I was hooked.

And that brings me here now, I suppose. I want to share my passion for SnK with you all through the creation of a Subverse, essentially providing yet another outlet for fans to share their thoughts, theories, cosplay, art, and more with other fans.

But like our friends over on Reddit, 4chan, and other community boards, there are a few guidelines that should be followed to keep order and maintain a sense of direction to ensure the best possible quality for this sub as a whole. This post is meant to serve as a simple introduction to the sub, and will highlight the rules and guidelines that all should follow to improve this sub in it's entirety.

RULES AND GUIDELINES

1. Be Respectful. Please remember that the downvote button is NOT an "I don't agree with you" button. If the original poster/commentor presents a relevant opinion that adds to the discussion of the topic at hand, then their post/comment should be upvoted. Also, always be courteous and consider others feelings before posting something that may otherwise offend.

2. Flair Your Posts Appropriately Before submitting a post, please remember to flair your post appropriately to avoid confusion or accidently spoiling the manga/anime for someone who is not quite caught up. It goes without saying that not everyone has the time to read/watch all of the series in one sitting, and thus may not be completely caught up yet. Also, this series still has new chapters releasing every month. It's still a learning experience for everyone.

3. NSFW Content is Allowed, but Rule 34 Should Be Avoided. In other words, gore is totally fine, but no pornographic images. Save that for Rule 34 subs and try to keep discussion meaningful.

4. Last But Not Least, Don't Stress and Have Fun. As a community, sharing our thoughts, ideas, theories, art, conspiracies, and more should be an enjoyable experience, as we all have something that brings us together, and that's our passion for an incredible series.

Well, I guess that raps things up. If you feel I missed anything or have any important questions you'd like to ask, feel free to do so. Oh, and if you'd like, you can also introduce yourself and let us know a little about.yourself in your comment like I did above. It can only serve to bring us closer as a community. :)

That's it, guys and gals. Enjoy yourselves, and remember, this is for the fate of humanity!
